purpose: Stage and independently review the fourth inert segment of the future Local Mistral review runner: deterministic fail-closed candidate validation plus canonical safe output without runtime activation.
requiredInvariants: The staged .inert file is not executed or referenced by any workflow.
Candidate content is bounded to 65536 UTF-8 bytes and must contain no thinking tags.

Candidate JSON is fail-closed: exact findings-only top-level shape, at most one finding, exact finding field set, P0/P1/P2 severity allowlist, exact changed-path authority, positive integer line, bounded title and reason, and speculative-reason rejection.
Credential-like content in title/reason returns no publishable canonical candidate; common e-mail/phone PII is redacted before canonicalization.
The validator returns a canonical safe JSON string separately from the raw model text; future publication authority must consume only that canonical safe value.
An empty findings array is canonicalized to exactly {"findings":[]} and is the only clean result; malformed or ambiguous output never becomes PASS.
Local Qwen workflow and exact-head verifier remain unchanged and are the independent authority for this PR.
No product, API, database, RBAC, registration, cabinet, customer-data or production routing behavior changes.
Production hosting remains REG.RU only and new recurring cost remains 0 RUB.
